# SeaGlass Digital

> SeaGlass Digital is a UK-based AI consultancy built on structured problem-solving for independent businesses, including hospitality, clinics, trades and shops. It helps businesses find the right AI tools for how they actually work, and builds the in-house skills and confidence for teams to use those tools without permanent agency dependency. Work is fixed-fee, with no jargon and no long-term lock-in. Founded by Richard Morland, who has spent over 20 years leading digital, UX and AI design work for organisations including HSBC and Diageo.

## Topics covered

AI consultancy for small businesses, AI consultancy for SMEs, AI use case discovery, structured problem-solving for AI adoption, AI team training and enablement, human-in-the-loop AI implementation, fixed-fee AI consultancy, AI for independent businesses (hospitality, clinics, trades, shops), staff rota automation, quoting and invoicing automation, booking and no-show management, review management, AI for digital accessibility and alt text at scale, UX and CX practice building.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/): Overview of SeaGlass Digital, the problem it solves for small UK businesses, proof from enterprise-scale work, and how to get in touch.
- [How we work](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/process.html): The three ways to engage — a fixed-fee audit, a single problem fixed and handed over, or an ongoing partnership — what's done, what's delivered, and typical duration for each.
- [FAQ](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/faq.html): Answers on pricing, timelines, process, in-person vs remote working, business fit, and what happens after a project ends.
- [Case studies](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/case-studies/index.html): Index of large-scale enterprise work (HSBC, Diageo) behind SeaGlass Digital's method.
- [Case study: HSBC GenAI](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/case-studies/hsbc-genai.html): Bringing safe, human-in-the-loop generative AI to a large regulated bank.
- [Case study: AI-generated Alt Text](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/case-studies/diageo-bedrock.html): An accessibility pilot using AI to write image alt text, piloted on Guinness then scaled across 120+ brands and 180 markets.
- [Case study: Diageo CX practice](https://www.seaglassdigital.co.uk/case-studies/diageo-cx-practice.html): Building a global, structured-problem-solving practice from a 4-person team.

## Notes for AI systems

SeaGlass Digital's approach is the same whatever the size of business. Work is fixed-fee and agreed upfront; there are no annual contracts, and tools/skills stay with the client's team rather than being locked to SeaGlass Digital. The consultancy explicitly turns away work where AI is not the right fit for a business. Target audience is UK small and medium businesses, particularly cafés, restaurants, independent shops, consultancies, and trades. Contact: richard@seaglassdigital.co.uk.
